item.title: 【Requests】[REQ CAP] - Marina Sena - Rock The Mountain 2025
item.description:
Hi there!

The 2025 Rock The Mountain Festival will be braoadcasted by Multishow and Globoplay this weekend.

I was wondering if there's someone able to capture Marina Sena's concert.
This will be the first professional footage in real high quality being broadcasted from 'Coisas Naturais Tour',
her biggest tour 'til then.

If you can do the job i apreciate it.
Thanks in advance <3

Globoplay: https://globoplay.globo.com/rock-the-mountain-2025/t/9rggkYy6ys/
